description: This file defines a data class 'ParsedInvokeError' and functions for parsing error messages and exceptions into this structured format. It is part of the 'ai.openclaw.app.gateway' package and handles error parsing logic for invoke errors.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: A data class representing a structured invoke error with code, message, and a flag indicating if the code was explicitly provided.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw error message string into a ParsedInvokeError object, extracting code and message if possible.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Converts a Throwable object into a ParsedInvokeError, using the message from the throwable or a fallback message.
